# CLIENT: GEARWORKS SUPPLY (fixture)

A second client, for the Replace-the-client test (#240 D12 addendum, #267). A
machine-shop parts distributor's weekly note: different topic, different
audience, different sourcing policy, a different ending, a conditional
obligation Never Blank does not have, and a banned-phrase list Never Blank does
not keep. Every one of those is a document here; none of them is Python.

`NB_CLIENT_DIR` points at this directory and the same Engine runs, unchanged.

The `GEARWORKS-…-CANARY` strings are deliberate. They are how
`tests/test_editorial_plan.py` proves that what is written here reaches the
messages a model actually receives, rather than merely parsing.
